title: Will Inuit in Canada Seek Chinese Partnerships Amid Strained Ties with Ottawa?
summary: Amid strained relations with Ottawa, Canadian Inuit leaders are exploring new partnerships with countries like the PRC. Under Prime Minister Mark Carney, Inuit organizations feel sidelined in favor of territorial governments, raising concerns about their role in resource development and self-determination.

Analysts believe Xi will continue to exert decisive influence over military affairs, solidifying his dominance over the party-state.
